Is there some questey-storyline type stuff as opposed to PVP twitch gaming against some 12 year old korean kid who is amazing...

There is a little bit of all of that. I will continue on that in a moment (sorry, working and all)

So ATM still waiting on the 2.5 update (soonTM) There is about 10 different "quests" (more like quest-lite) that you can do where the game more or less points you in a direction and asks you to fulfill a chore with a little bit of a background. Persistence is in the game, i.e. you can do quests or other activities to earn Alpha-UEC (ingame credits) that you can then use to refit your ship and buy clothes/FPS weapons for your character. There are plenty of other things being worked on that are available at the moment. There is a Guardian/Bandit rating system in effect that basically gets auto assigned when you kill enough innocent players disable comm-arrays, ect, and puts a bounty on your head. Conversely the same thing for "Guardians" that do good deeds. There is also some random explore/salvage game play in certain areas where you can pick up loot crates from wrecks in asteroid fields. Also there is a bit of FPS elements that are in existence and growing with each patch.

Through out any activity on the Persistent Universe (PU for short) there will be the risk of PVP and PVE by way of pirates and navigational challenges (flying through asteroid fields). That is where the pesky 12yr olds come in. There is a bit of "griefing" but in my experience it isn't so bad as to really take away from the playability. (just kill them first, or run away)

Additionally there is still the "Arena" that you can jump in and out of at will to practice flying/fighting. It offers a myriad of options for players to practice: Racing, Co-operative space battles, PVP Freeforall, there was even a game like space basketball there for a while... I don't know if it is still available as I have spent the majority of my time in the PU over the last couple of months.

Again, this game is still very much so in development. There are plenty of glitches and problems. You will often clip right out of a ship if you are running around it while your friend is piloting. There are connection issues, frame rate problems, and countless other blockers that are constantly being adjusted and worked on. The game is still a long way from being "released" officially.

Feel free to ask any questions and I will do my best to at least point you in the right direction.
